name: MySSL subdomain discovery API (myssl.com)
tier_rationale: Terms not reviewed; CN operator (queried domains are disclosed to a service in China: OPSEC and data residency). Chair decision P016: myssl.com is a separate toggle with terms 'unknown' and stays unknown tier until a promotion is recorded.

reliability.justification: Hosts seen in MySSL's own TLS scans (with IP, port and TLS grade); the answer is per registrable domain and looked static between two days.

discover_sub_domain.title: MySSL subdomain discovery (GET /api/v1/discover_sub_domain?domain={domain} -> {code, data[{domain, ip, port, level_str, is_sslvpn, evaluate_date}]})

terms.quote: myssl.com (CN operator, terms not reviewed) and RapidDNS (HTML scraping) are separate toggles with terms 'unknown' until legal records them

discover_sub_domain.notes: Quote: binding council text (P016 cond 3). Research C0035; code != 0 is a partial/error flag (P016 cond 5). IPs and TLS grades are kept as attributes only, never pivoted. Off unless setting subdomains_passive_extra_myssl is enabled and legal records the terms.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G01-3 (P016, module subdomains_passive_extra, toggle subdomains_passive_extra_myssl).
